change_proposal.Recommendation: Keep the v51 SP500/SPCX entry, stop, opposite-signal exit, and 100/40/80 completed-bar profit-lock contracts unchanged while resolving the open SP500 short and collecting the first long lifecycle.
change_proposal.Why now: The first current-run SPCX short resolved and the first SP500 short is open, creating direct source-native evidence but not enough both-side or repeatability evidence for retuning.
change_proposal.Evidence reviewed: Two immutable live-condition diagnostics, one immutable 88-decision backend-observer parity report, the resolved SPCX lifecycle journal, and the open SP500 lifecycle journal.
change_proposal.Observed problem or opportunity: Technical attribution is now verified, but economic evidence consists of one profitable SPCX short and one unresolved SP500 short; no long signal has occurred.
change_proposal.Applicable market regime: Fresh 15-minute HIP-3 price breakout with EMA21/55 direction and same-boundary top-ten pressure confirmation under the v51 source-native contract.
change_proposal.Alternatives considered: Lower the 32-bar breakout threshold, relax the pressure threshold, change the 80-bps stop, retune the profit lock after one winner, remove the routes, or preserve the frozen contracts and collect exact both-side evidence.
change_proposal.Expected upside: Preserves a technically validated live route and avoids selecting entry or exit parameters from one favorable short while obtaining exact evidence on the next lifecycle.
change_proposal.Main risks and failure modes: Sparse one-sided evidence, completed-bar profit-lock gap risk, backend dependence before the lock triggers, replay timing optimism, source gaps, and largest-winner concentration.
change_proposal.Validation completed: Forty-four common decisions per symbol matched exactly with zero backend-observer mismatches; all 45 diagnostic decisions per symbol had fresh and history-complete pressure; the SPCX close reconciled entry, stop, profit-lock trigger, fills, fees, funding, and final flat state.
change_proposal.Validation still required: Resolve the SP500 short, collect at least one fully resolved long and additional shorts, measure live-minus-stress residuals, perform largest-winner sensitivity on a larger sample, and evaluate shared-portfolio co-trigger behavior.
change_proposal.Success metrics: Exact source/backend and live/replay branch parity, no unprotected or orphaned lifecycle, positive combined and side-separated after-cost results, positive net excluding the largest winner once sample size permits, and bounded execution residuals.
change_proposal.Failure / rollback triggers: Any source/backend mismatch, unprotected exposure, stale or conflicting source identity, exit-branch mismatch, repeated execution drag beyond stress, or a predeclared compatible sample with adverse after-cost expectancy.
change_proposal.Confidence level: High confidence in current technical parity; low confidence in profitability because only one lifecycle is resolved and it is one-sided.
